name: Andy Matuschak
role: Applied researcher · tools that expand thought
bio: Andy Matuschak is an applied researcher focused on user interfaces that expand what people can think and do. Public work includes Quantum Country and an augmented book that helps people understand and remember what they read. Previously helped build iOS at Apple and led R&D at Khan Academy.
highlights: Evergreen notes: concept-oriented, linked, continuously refined.
